limits: Retrospective after the target maps were examined. The development and target map identities do not establish independent specimens. Detector normalization still uses training pixels from each target map.
scope: Estimate a single even gain and offset across all channels of each of four development maps after training-range normalization. Use medians to transfer those parameters to ten other maps. Include one median response for all models and the ideal response. The ten targets supply geometry and training-pixel intensity quantiles; the gain and offset receive no target-model fit.
